annotation_method: Human visual estimates on complete source PNGs at 1254 x 1254; annotated derivatives visually checked against source anatomy. No model-generated landmarks. No image warping.
coordinate_system_note: top-left origin, x right, y down; boxes [left,top,right,bottom] in source pixels; source and component mask bounds use exclusive right/bottom; manual anatomical boxes approximate continuous extents
manual_uncertainty_note: Approximate per-coordinate uncertainty; anatomical boundaries under occlusion are not established ground truth. This is not an accuracy confidence interval. A 3% dimension threshold can be smaller than this annotation uncertainty for ears or feet; borderline results require visual review.
silhouette_method: alpha >=128, largest 8-connected component; full alpha bbox also recorded because cutout images have disconnected low-alpha edge artifacts
